ThingDef.label: large simple meal
ThingDef.description:
Large meal.

1.8 nutrition / 1.8 L at 1x density.
Consumed whole; unusable food is wasted.

ThingDef.label: feast-sized simple meal
ThingDef.description:
Feast-sized meal.

3.6 nutrition / 3.6 L at 1x density.
Consumed whole; unusable food is wasted.

ThingDef.label: enormous simple meal
ThingDef.description: Legacy oversized stock: 4 nutrition and 4 stomach volume at 1x. Retained for existing saves. New cooking uses Standard, Large and Feast portions; old bills produce matching Feast batches.

ThingDef.label: massive simple meal
ThingDef.description: Legacy oversized stock: 6 nutrition and 6 stomach volume at 1x. Retained for existing saves. New cooking uses Standard, Large and Feast portions; old bills produce matching Feast batches.

ThingDef.label: colossal simple meal
ThingDef.description: Legacy oversized stock: 15 nutrition and 15 stomach volume at 1x. Retained for existing saves. New cooking uses Standard, Large and Feast portions; old bills produce matching Feast batches.
